build_BaggingClassifier: build a BaggingClassifier ensemble with DecisionTreeClassifier base estimator and bootstrap sampling on iris data
build_BaggingRegressor: build a BaggingRegressor ensemble with DecisionTreeRegressor base estimator and OOB score evaluation on diabetes data
test_warm_start_fitting: test incremental warm_start fitting of BaggingClassifier to add estimators without refitting from scratch
test_parallel_execution: test parallel execution of BaggingClassifier with n_jobs parameter for multi-threaded prediction
test_metadata_routing: test metadata routing of sample_weight and custom metadata through BaggingClassifier to sub-estimators
